QuestInfo.name: A Special Assignment
QuestInfo.0: #p1022002# of #m102000000# seems to have something to tell me...
QuestInfo.1: #p1022002# received a word from a group of strangers to relay a message to me. #b'Go visit #p2012019# of #m200000000#.'#k. #p1022002# tells me he doesn't know anything else.
QuestInfo.2: At #m200000000#, I met #p2012019#, carrying a small box around its neck.

0.0: 그렇지 않아도 자네를 기다리고 있었네. 수상한 자가 자네에게 전해달라면서 쪽지를 전해 주고 갔어. 그런데 그만 내 부주의로 쪽지가 불에 타버리고 말았네. 하지만 내용은 확실하게 기억하고 있네. 관심있나?

yes.0: 쪽지엔 이렇게 적혀 있었지. #b'#m200000000#에 있는 #p2012019#를 찾아가시오.'#k 그게 다 였네.

no.0: 관심이 없다면 굳이 내용을 알 필요가 없겠지.

0.0: I've been waiting for you. A stranger came by and asked me to pass you this note. Unfortunately, I got careless and wound up burning the note, but I do remember what was written on it. Are you interested in hearing what I can remember?

yes.0: The note said this: #b'Pick up #p2012019# in #m200000000#.'#k That was it. I'm sorry my memory isn't better...

no.0: If you're not interested, then there's no point of you knowing what's in it.

1.0: Bark, bark! (Wagging its tail in delight.)

npc.0: The note said this: #b'Pick up #p2012019# in #m200000000#.'#k That was it.
